name: Illiyana
summary: Illiyana is an ancient dryad stationed in eastern Ashenvale, dedicated to protecting the woodland from ancient corruption. Wandering near Forest Song, she rallies champions of the Alliance to push back against the vicious satyrs that plague the ancient groves. Her vigilance represents the enduring bond between the daughters of Cenarius and the night elven wilderness.

sections.title: Daughter of the Forest
sections.body: Like all dryads, Illiyana is one of the daughters of the demigod Cenarius. Peaceful yet fiercely protective of wild lands, she patrols the woods of eastern Ashenvale. As dark forces stir and the woodlands suffer under creeping corruption, Illiyana keeps watch over sacred relics and groves, acting as a steward for nature's primal sanctity.

sections.title: The Threat of the Satyr
sections.body: Illiyana's primary concern in the region is the lingering blight of the satyrs. These twisted, demonic creatures continuously seek to corrupt the glades and endanger her dryad sisters. Illiyana frequently enlists passing travelers to strike down these vile abominations and recover lost artifacts, including the Branch of Cenarius, to ensure the woods remain sheltered from demonic taint.

faq.answer: Illiyana is a dryad found roaming eastern Ashenvale near Forest Song. As a daughter of Cenarius, she dedicates her existence to watching over the wildlands and protecting her sisters from demonic forces.

faq.q: Why does Illiyana keep walking while I talk to her?
faq.answer: Illiyana maintains an active patrol route through the woodland. Unlike stationary quest givers, she continues her watchful pacing through the grove even when engaging in conversation with travelers.
She calls upon adventurers to hunt down vile satyrs that menace the region and to recover sacred relics like the Branch of Cenarius to safeguard her fellow dryads.
She patrols near the outpost of Forest Song in eastern Ashenvale, keeping watch along the paths and nearby groves.

faq.q: Why are the dryads in danger from satyrs?
faq.answer: Satyrs are ancient night elves warped by demonic corruption who delight in defiling nature and subjugating Cenarius's children. Dryads represent the pure, untainted beauty of the forest, making them prime targets for satyr malice.
No. Illiyana is allied with the Night Elves and the broader Alliance. Horde members venturing into her glade will find her and her allies hostile.

angles.text: For the Kaldorei, dryads like Illiyana are sacred kin of Cenarius, revered protectors whose call to arms against demonic satyrs is answered without hesitation.
Druids hold dryads in high regard as embodiments of the wild, and helping Illiyana preserve the sanctified glades aligns directly with the Cenarion duty to heal the land.
Illiyana represents a vital woodland ally in eastern Ashenvale, offering shelter and guidance to Alliance forces securing the wilderness against encroaching evils.
